div.head: VI Atr 3a
div.ab: gebuge georne into mynstre mid eallum eaðmettum ⁊ misdæda geswice ⁊ bete swyþe georne þæt he abrocen hæbbe; geþence word ⁊ wedd, þe he Gode betæhte.
gebuge georne into mynstre mid eallum eaðmettum ⁊ misdæda geswice ⁊ bete swyþe georne þæt he abrocen hæbbe; geþence word ⁊ wedd þe he Gode betæhte.
gebuge georne into mynstre mid eallum eaðmettum and misdæda geswice and bete swyþe georne þæt he abrocen hæbbe. Geþence word and wedd, þe he Gode betæhte.
willig unterwerfe er sich dem Kloster mit aller Demuth und stehe ab von Missethaten und büsse höchst eifrig, was er verbrochen hat; er bedenke Wort und Verpflichtung, die er Gott gegeben hat!
let him submit willingly to the monastery with all humility, and desist from misdeeds and atone most eagerly for what he has violated; let him remember the word and pledge which he gave to God!

he shall readily return into the monastery with all humility, and desist from his evil ways, and zealously make amends for the transgressions he has committed. Let him remember the vows which he rendered to God.

readily surrender himself to a monastery with all humility, and renounce his misdeeds, and sincerely repent for the rules he has broken. Let him reflect upon the word and pledge that he devoted to God.
